Design
We do not follow design
trends. We set them.
Exceptional beauty blazes
its own trail.
It may be its muscular silhouette that first captures your imagination, or maybe it’s the way its increased
ride height and widened track tell a story of adventure off the beaten path. Whatever it is, you know it
didn’t arrive here by following others. That’s why it’s possible to stare at the allroad® for hours and still
not pinpoint its most alluring feature. So let us offer some insight. Something we call the Tornado line,
a characteristic crease that lies below the window line, draws your eye along a flowing path from front
to rear. This line, combined with the fender cladding and robust aluminum roof rails, adds to its mag-
netic appeal. And while it may be difficult to pin down, its beauty is a product of taking its own path.
